title: CSAFE Handwriting Database v2: external application of the BanglaHand writer-independent protocol (IJDAR)
written: 2026-11-12, before any outcome of this protocol was computed
prior_knowledge: Handedness accuracies of whole-page HC-183 and STROKE on this 96-writer cohort under a different protocol (session-1 training, single query pages, Platt calibration; IET Biometrics submission, Supporting Information S13/S16) were known to the authors. The representations, conditions, endpoints and primary hypotheses below are fixed without reference to any result of this protocol.
dataset: CSAFE Handwriting Database v2, doi:10.25380/iastate.10062203.v2, CC BY 4.0; local copy external/csafe_v2 (selected pages only).
cohort: The 96 writers of the earlier deterministic selection: all 48 left-handed writers with a binary hand label and 48 right-handed writers drawn with a fixed seed; ambidextrous and missing-hand writers excluded. No writer or page is added or removed on the basis of results.

conditions.A: train and test on session-1 pages (paragraphs 1-6), writer-independent
conditions.X: model A applied to the test writers' later-session pages (paragraphs 7-9)
conditions.C2: model A applied to session-2 pages only (paragraphs 7-8)
conditions.C3: model A applied to the session-3 page (paragraph 9)

evaluation: Identical to BanglaHand: stratified five-fold writer CV repeated with seeds 2026-2045; every page of a test writer held out; linear SVM C = 0.1 (primary), logistic regression and random forest tuned on training writers (secondary); writer called left-handed if the mean page margin >= 0; endpoint writer balanced accuracy averaged over repetitions; 999 whole-writer permutations with folds regenerated; 95% class-stratified writer-bootstrap interval (2,000 resamples).

representations.hc183_tb: PRIMARY. HC-183 (run_crop_evaluation.ink_features on the 768-px ink) cropped to the text block, as the line-free text-block estimate on BanglaHand.
representations.hc183_page: HC-183 on the whole scanned page (comparison; includes the share of the page the writing occupies).
representations.resnet18, efficientnet_b0, vit_b_16: frozen ImageNet embeddings of 224-px tiles with >= 1% ink (extract_final_features.tiles).
representations.global_intensity, background: acquisition controls: seven grey-level statistics of the whole scan and of paper pixels only.
representations.layout: page-occupancy and layout measures (text-block position and extent, skew, line slope, spacing, margins; printed-line detector expected to find none).

adjustment: Ink density and the seven photo-intensity statistics regressed out of every feature within training folds (as on BanglaHand).
audits: Writer-identification top-1 (leave-one-page-out 1-NN on session-1 pages) and paragraph BA under image-level versus writer-level folds.

primary_hypotheses.H1: hc183_tb, SVM, condition A: writer BA > 0.5 (permutation test)
primary_hypotheses.H2: hc183_tb, SVM, condition X: writer BA > 0.5 (permutation test with model A refitted under permuted labels)

multiplicity: Holm over H1 and H2; everything else secondary and descriptive.
not_applicable: MATRA-INK (Latin script has no headstroke); printed-border analysis (no printed lines on these scans; checked by the detector).
